bukti: The processing pipeline consists of preprocessing, object detection, and yield estimation.
The object detector, being the most computationally expensive module, is invoked every nth frame due to video redundancy and the target platform’s limited resources.

bukti: Using a monocular camera, we applied the YOLOv4 neural network algorithm to extract the deep features of banana fruits, realizing accurate detection of different banana sizes.
The detection algorithm achieved a 99.29% detection rate, the average execution time was 0.171s, the shortest execution time was 0.135s, and the AP was 0.9995.
catatan: Hanya deteksi satu kelas dari citra tunggal; pencacahan, atribut kelas, dan estimasi hasil hanya disebut sebagai manfaat lanjutan, tidak dievaluasi.

bukti: In this paper, several object detection algorithms were investigated to classify the ripeness of oil palm fresh fruit bunch.
The models were trained on a dataset with four main ripeness classes: ripe, unripe, half-ripe, and over-ripe.
catatan: Abstrak tidak menyebut lokasi pengambilan citra (pohon, tanah, atau pabrik). Tugas dikodekan DET karena memakai detektor objek dengan kelas kematangan; tidak ada pencacahan.

bukti: Key steps included creating orthophotos, segmenting data into tiles, training a convolutional neural network (CNN) with transfer learning and data augmentation, and merging results.
An experimentally determined correction coefficient will account for fruits hidden from the camera, enhancing the accuracy of yield estimation.

Koefisien koreksi baru direncanakan, belum dievaluasi. Evaluasi hanya pada tingkat deteksi.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Faster R-CNN pada potongan ortomosaik mencapai presisi 0,93, recall 0,90, F1 0,91, dan akurasi 88,96% terhadap hitungan manual pada 20 citra. Regresi linear jumlah buah pada citra terhadap buah dipanen (19 pohon) memberi R2 0,80, MAE 128,56, RMSE 130,56.

bukti: Then, the orthomosaic was cropped using these shapefiles, and a TIF file was obtained for each tree as an output. Finally, each TIF file was tested using the Faster R-CNN model to count apple fruits.
As only parts of the tree fruits were visible in the top-view images, linear regression was used to estimate the number of total apples on each tree.
These latter were obtained with a forward overlap of 85% and a sideway overlap of 75%.
catatan: Pencacahan dilakukan per pohon pada satu potongan ortomosaik nadir, sehingga saat deteksi setiap buah muncul satu kali (C2).
